ws2['A1'] = 'Year'
ws2['B1'] = 'CA changes'
ws2['C1'] = 'FA changes'
ws2['D1'] = 'OA changes'

# Data from Sheet1
# 2014: CA=185682, FA=45500, OA=3580
# 2015: CA=204527, FA=43243, OA=3520
# 2016: CA=219289, FA=40840, OA=3726
# 2017: CA=248718, FA=38419, OA=4011
# 2018: CA=264792, FA=35854, OA=4030
# 2019: CA=282148, FA=33181, OA=4088

years = [2015, 2016, 2017, 2018, 2019]
# Reference Sheet1 rows: 2014=row2, 2015=row3, 2016=row4, 2017=row5, 2018=row6, 2019=row7
for i, year in enumerate(years):
    row = i + 2  # rows 2..6
    sheet1_curr_row = i + 3  # rows 3..7 (2015..2019)
    sheet1_prev_row = i + 2  # rows 2..6 (2014..2018)
    ws2.cell(row=row, column=1, value=year)

    ws2.cell(row=row, column=4, value=f"=(Sheet1.D{sheet1_curr_row}-Sheet1.D{sheet1_prev_row})/Sheet1.D{sheet1_prev_row}")
    # Format as percentage

wb.save('/home/user/SmallBalanceSheet.xlsx')
print("Saved successfully")

python3 << 'EOF'
import openpyxl
wb = openpyxl.load_workbook('/home/user/SmallBalanceSheet.xlsx')

if 'Sheet2' in wb.sheetnames:
    del wb['Sheet2']
ws2 = wb.create_sheet('Sheet2')

ws2['A1'] = 'Year'
ws2['B1'] = 'CA changes'
ws2['C1'] = 'FA changes'
ws2['D1'] = 'OA changes'

years = [2015, 2016, 2017, 2018, 2019]
for i, year in enumerate(years):
    row = i + 2
    sheet1_curr_row = i + 3
    sheet1_prev_row = i + 2
    ws2.cell(row=row, column=1, value=year)
    ws2.cell(row=row, column=2, value=f"=(Sheet1!B{sheet1_curr_row}-Sheet1!B{sheet1_prev_row})/Sheet1!B{sheet1_prev_row}")
    ws2.cell(row=row, column=3, value=f"=(Sheet1!C{sheet1_curr_row}-Sheet1!C{sheet1_prev_row})/Sheet1!C{sheet1_prev_row}")
    ws2.cell(row=row, column=4, value=f"=(Sheet1!D{sheet1_curr_row}-Sheet1!D{sheet1_prev_row})/Sheet1!D{sheet1_prev_row}")
    for col in [2, 3, 4]:
        ws2.cell(row=row, column=col).number_format = '0.00%'

wb.save('/home/user/SmallBalanceSheet.xlsx')
print("Saved with Excel-style references")
EOF
